summary.headline: Astrological Judgments on Illness
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging life, death, and illness from the Sun, planets, houses of life and death, combustion, conjunctions, aspects, reception, and the Almutes. The passage explains how the lord of the ascendant or Moon joined to fortunate or malefic planets affects the progression or resolution of sickness.
